summary: Added a runtime-derived negative authorization matrix covering every implemented route. The matrix classifies anonymous, refresh-session, role-protected, and signed-grant boundaries; records seeker/provider ownership or assignment scope; and records verified-admin RBAC mode and permission boundaries. Focused tests exercise route coverage plus missing, invalid, cross-role, unverified-admin, and verified-admin middleware cases without production credentials or data.
